source: legacy COM Tool + 2026-09-23 audit + remembered live-engine findings

policy.rule: Compatibility never overrides safety or truthful semantics.

features.legacyBehavior: Read host version/build, document count, UI/action state, active document summary.
defectsToAvoid: Nested property reads sometimes bypass retry.
Host health and script-engine health are conflated.

features.legacyBehavior: Capture active document and selection state through injected JSX.
defectsToAvoid: Standalone snapshot can wrap inner parse failure as outer success.
Snapshot shape is Illustrator-specific.

features.legacyBehavior: Resolve dotted COM path with zero-based collection indices and read a property.
defectsToAvoid: Empty path segments collapse silently.
Object summaries perform un-retried nested reads.
COM DOM must not be confused with JSX DOM.

features.legacyBehavior: Set one direct COM property.
defectsToAvoid: No first-class pre/postconditions.
No universal type-domain validation from inventory.
Ambiguous failure cannot be treated as non-execution.

features.legacyBehavior: Invoke arbitrary COM method with JSON arguments.
defectsToAvoid: Method domains can be mis-modeled, e.g. Document.Close Boolean vs AiSaveOptions.
Mutation risk is unknown from the raw call name.

features.legacyBehavior: Run ExtendScript through Illustrator DoJavaScript with wrappers, args, JSON helpers, error remapping.
defectsToAvoid: JSON-looking strings can lose type identity.
Static ES3 preflight is not authoritative.
RPC_E_SERVERFAULT can occur while ordinary COM reads remain healthy.

features.legacyBehavior: Auto-route directive-bearing JSX through $.evalFile; inject directive-free files.
defectsToAvoid: Injected and evalFile routes have materially different semantics.
Arguments and return behavior differ by route.

features.legacyBehavior: Fast static rejection of unsupported syntax before a host call.
defectsToAvoid: Regex-literal blind spots.
Reserved-word and host-parser edge cases.
Must not claim live-engine equivalence.

features.legacyBehavior: Run Illustrator actions and poll ActionIsRunning.
defectsToAvoid: UserInteractionLevel restoration can be lost.
Timeout phases can double-window.
Action success still requires postcondition.

features.legacyBehavior: Open an Illustrator document.
defectsToAvoid: Active-document state becomes an implicit dependency for later commands.
Lifecycle ownership is not explicit.

features.legacyBehavior: Close document with Boolean save argument.
defectsToAvoid: Wrong argument domain; Illustrator expects AiSaveOptions.
Implicit discard/save policies are unsafe.

features.legacyBehavior: Execute multiple operations in one COM session; continue after individual failures.
defectsToAvoid: Dependent stateful mutations continue after prerequisites fail.
No guards or target lease.

features.legacyBehavior: Persist steps across calls and resume; skip persisted done entries.
defectsToAvoid: At-least-once mutation replay after crash.
Multi-writer races.
Resume-safe wording overstates guarantees.

features.legacyBehavior: Keep one process/COM session alive while commands stream over stdin.
defectsToAvoid: Help wording implied persistence across later processes.
Duplicates concerns solved by real broker/runtime.

features.legacyBehavior: Poll COM path or JSX expression until expected/changed.
defectsToAvoid: Boolean vs numeric equality conflation.
A blocked provider defeats watch timeout.
Very low interval can hammer Illustrator.

features.legacyBehavior: File-backed agent-owned arbitrary state plus op counter.
defectsToAvoid: Filename sanitization aliases names.
Multi-writer lost updates.
Not host session state.
features.v2Operation: session handle only for real runtime/debug/workflow continuity

features.legacyBehavior: Spawn child process, persist task record, poll/cancel by PID.
defectsToAvoid: PID reuse cancellation hazard.
Cancel/finalize lost-update race.
running state not persisted.
task wait can return outer success for child failure.

features.legacyBehavior: Use Adobe ExtendScript Debugger transport; breakpoints persist in host.
defectsToAvoid: Version selection was lexicographic.
Default app spec version-tied.
One-off process model limits persistent debug conversation.
features.phase: Illustrator Wave D — persistent worker-owned session implemented

features.legacyBehavior: REPL-style debugger eval with suspension, stack/locals, continue/step control.
defectsToAvoid: Stateless CLI invocation conflicts with real debugger session continuity.
Bridge startup timeout can block.

features.legacyBehavior: Serialize one Illustrator automation invocation at a time.
defectsToAvoid: Abandoned mutex proves only deadlock recovery, not document consistency.
Metadata file is not ProgID-scoped and has release/delete races.

features.legacyBehavior: Retry only known COM busy/rejected/transient failures with bounded backoff.
defectsToAvoid: Deadline can be overshot by sleep.
Generic server faults need execution-certainty classification.

features.legacyBehavior: GetActiveObject then launch via Dispatch/EnsureDispatch.
defectsToAvoid: Ownership of launched vs preexisting host is implicit.
Target identity/generation is weak.

features.legacyBehavior: One machine-readable envelope with ok/op/result/error/hresult/suggestion and 0/1/2 exit classes.
defectsToAvoid: Some nested failures become outer success.
Retryability and execution certainty are not orthogonal fields.

features.legacyBehavior: Write oversized results to temp files with cleanup.
defectsToAvoid: Byte count can actually be character count.
Temp-path contract is not a general artifact model.

features.legacyBehavior: Bootstrap shared JSON facade/native acceleration into ExtendScript global engine state.
defectsToAvoid: Optimization mutates unrelated shared JSON/ESPAK state.
Consumer ESPAK state can be clobbered.
Correctness semantics must not depend on acceleration lane.
features.v2Operation: script.eval ESON codec / optional measured accelerator
features.phase: Wave A runtime codec implemented/live; ESPACK optional

features.legacyBehavior: Extract copy-paste examples from Markdown command reference.
defectsToAvoid: Docs can drift from parser/implementation.
Human examples are larger than necessary for agents.

features.legacyBehavior: Search type library inventory, signatures, enums, interface paths.
defectsToAvoid: Illustrator-only naming/layout.
Source/version provenance must be stronger.
Cross-DOM names can look deceptively similar.

features.legacyBehavior: Reach native .aip plugins only when they expose a compatible SendScriptMessage contract.
defectsToAvoid: Not arbitrary native debugger access.
Plugin calls from background IPC threads must not invoke Illustrator suites directly.
features.phase: Illustrator Wave E — generic bridge implemented

features.legacyBehavior: Choose among direct COM, injected JSX, actions/menu commands, and native plugin routes.
defectsToAvoid: Undocumented strings are version brittle.
Routing heuristics should not be hidden.

features.legacyBehavior: Atomic replace JSON files for queue/task/session metadata.
defectsToAvoid: Atomic replace is not multi-writer serialization.
Corrupt state can be treated as missing and overwritten.

features.legacyBehavior: Validate skill/reference assets.
defectsToAvoid: Legacy validator did not actually validate highest-risk comtool implementation.
